description: Send a natural-language question to the analysis engine. Reads business data without modifying it, but creates QueryMind query jobs, audit records, conversation context and usage records. Returns an answer, state, limited result rows and evidence. If state=clarifying_question, ask the user the returned question before calling clarify.

question.description: The user's natural-language data question; preserve their business meaning.

name: ask
title: Ask about your data
